# MP Production

> Mumbai-based premier cinematic film production house and creative agency specializing in high-fashion lookbooks, automotive ad films, commercial cinema (TVCs), product launch videos,Dolby Vision color grading, and exclusive talent representation.

## Core Services
1. **Commercial Cinema & TVC Production**: End-to-end commercial film production with 4K/8K anamorphic camera packages (ARRI Alexa 35, RED V-Raptor), master gaffer lighting, and award-winning directors.
2. **Pre-Production & Creative Direction**: Concept ideation, scriptwriting, visual storyboarding, comprehensive location scouting across India & abroad, and casting.
3. **High-Fashion Lookbooks & Editorial Photography**: Runway and atelier fashion campaigns, prime master glass, and theatrical high-end retouching.
4. **Post-Production & Dolby Vision Color Grading**: Theatrical editing suites, Kodak 2383 35mm film emulation, Dolby Vision HDR mastering, and spatial sound design.
5. **Exclusive Talent Roster & Casting Agency**: Over 1,200 verified models, cinematic actors, voice artists, and visual directors with streamlined escrow bookings.
6. **Digital Campaigns & Viral 9:16 Social Suites**: Algorithm-tailored hooks, high-retention social-first campaign reels, and omnichannel brand assets.
